title: .NET 6 End of Support
author: boringnerd
content:
Topic
As per the 
compatibility matrix
, currently Nintex K2 Five (5.6) and Nintex Automation (5.7) are the only two versions that support .NET 6.0.
According to 
Microsoft
, official support for .NET 6 is ending on November 12, 2024.
Instructions 
At the time this KB is written, Nintex Automation (5.8) is the only version that supports .NET 8. If you have a requirement to update .NET 6 to .NET 8, please consider upgrading your K2 environment to 5.8 as it is currently the only version that supports .NET 8.
When in doubt. please refer to our compatibility matrix (
https://help.nintex.com/en-US/platform/K2Support/ProductCompatibilityMatrix.htm#.NET_Core
) on the latest product compatibility. Any updates to .NET 8 compatibility will be reflected in the compatibility matrix.
